bundle.js includes pako 2.1.0 (MIT AND Zlib), as its own header says, and the
flasher stubs for every chip. It makes no network request of its own.

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the flasher makes no third-party
request (the static site's rule) and works from the household server's
localhost copy without internet access. Version chosen to match the page
upstream already ran on this hardware (docs/flash/index.html, 0.6.1).
To update: replace both files from the new package, update this note and the
import path in ../../flasher.js; tests/test_flasher.py checks the hash below.
